scope: E4a-E4c all artifact inventory, canonical news row audit, social source feasibility; no model fitting
counting: Separate source/dataset version, stock link, content representation and feature view. Canonical datasets are not summed into unique articles without cross-source deduplication.

PIT_levels.L1: date proxy or unverified UTC-midnight precision
PIT_levels.L3: exact historical content version plus independently verified source-public time or dated historical capture
PIT_levels.L4: L3 plus certified provider arrival; current retrieval is never historical arrival

future_feature_clocks: Text observation and semantic model release/revision/inference clocks are distinct; retrospective feature extraction is not historical deployed prediction.
unknown_not_zero: No source observation ledger -> monitoring coverage and true no-news rates remain NA. Zero retained rows only describes fixed local snapshot.

E8b_screening_gates_not_power_guarantees.research_use: documented permission/terms compatible with intended research, deletion compliance and reproduction policy
E8b_screening_gates_not_power_guarantees.strict_PIT: 100% records used have exact-version evidence and certified availability <= cutoff; unresolved records excluded, missingness retained
E8b_screening_gates_not_power_guarantees.source_continuity: same declared source/query at least2train+1validation+1test years; >=90% documented monitored sessions in EACH partition
E8b_screening_gates_not_power_guarantees.manual_QA: 100 stratified document/version checks including both tickers, boundary times and edits; zero critical future/version errors; >=95% entity relevance on reviewed sample
E8b_screening_gates_not_power_guarantees.inference: paired common dates, source ablations, metadata/constant-shrink controls; development-only dependence and joint-comparison power check required before any formal comparison
E8b_screening_gates_not_power_guarantees.independence: 2024-2025 already inspected, cannot be new confirmation; E8 needs separately preregistered unseen future period, E3c2026 unchanged

E8b_exploratory_only: If strict gates fail, a date-proxy sensitivity case study may be separately specified, never renamed formal PIT. No such training in E8a.
social: Only primary official documentation and author datasets; no unauthorized access, payment, new keys, user contact or current social/2026 content collection.
threshold_note: Engineering screening targets fixed before new E8a row-level audit; not empirically powered requirements or retrospective E4 pass/fail claims.
